interpretation_ko: 안 좋은 영향에 굴복해 일에서 중요한 승리를 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: you will surely succumb to ill-favored influences and lose important victories in your affairs

cite.original:
To dream that you find a wall obstructing your progress,
you will surely succumb to ill-favored influences and lose
important victories in your affairs.
cite.translation_ko: 벽이 앞길을 막고 있음을 보는 꿈은, 안 좋은 영향에 굴복해 일에서 중요한 승리를 잃을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: you will overcome obstacles and win your desires

cite.original: To jump over it, you will overcome obstacles and win your desires.
cite.translation_ko: 벽을 뛰어넘는 꿈은, 장애를 이겨내고 바람을 이룰 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 끈질긴 의지로 바라던 바를 이룰 조짐
interpretation_en: you will succeed in the attainment of your wishes by sheer tenacity of purpose

cite.original:
To force a breach in a wall, you will succeed in the attainment
of your wishes by sheer tenacity of purpose.
cite.translation_ko: 벽에 구멍을 내는 꿈은, 끈질긴 의지로 바라던 바를 이룰 조짐이다

cite.original: To demolish one, you will overthrow your enemies.
cite.translation_ko: 벽을 허무는 꿈은, 적을 무너뜨릴 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 실패와 교활한 적을 물리치고 계획을 세워 재산을 굳건히 할 조짐
interpretation_en: foretells that you will carefully lay plans and will solidify your fortune to the exclusion of failure, or designing enemies

cite.original:
To build one, foretells that you will carefully lay plans
and will solidify your fortune to the exclusion of failure,
or designing enemies.
cite.translation_ko: 벽을 쌓는 꿈은, 실패와 교활한 적을 물리치고 계획을 세워 재산을 굳건히 할 조짐이다

interpretation_en: shows that her future happiness will soon be made secure

cite.original:
For a young woman to walk on top of a wall, shows that her future
happiness will soon be made secure.
cite.translation_ko: 젊은 여성이 벽 위를 걷는 꿈은, 미래의 행복이 곧 굳건해질 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that she will form connections that she will be ashamed to acknowledge

cite.original:
For her to hide behind
a wall, denotes that she will form connections that she will
be ashamed to acknowledge.
cite.translation_ko: 젊은 여성이 벽 뒤에 숨는 꿈은, 부끄러워할 만한 관계를 맺을 조짐이다

context: 젊은 여성이 낮은 벽 옆을 걸음
interpretation_ko: 매력을 다 써버리고 위태로운 때에 버림받을 조짐
interpretation_en: she will soon have run the gamut of her attractions, and will likely be deserted at a precarious time

cite.original:
If she walks beside a base wall.
she will soon have run the gamut of her attractions, and will
likely be deserted at a precarious time.
cite.translation_ko: 젊은 여성이 낮은 벽 옆을 걷는 꿈은, 매력을 다 써버리고 위태로운 때에 버림받을 조짐이다
